title: Listing Card — Compact
description:
The related-items card carried by the carousels on every Tour Operator single — "Tours in Botswana", "Accommodation in Botswana", the destination rail. A landscape image sits above a tinted panel that centres the title and the taxonomy read-outs. Measured from `.single .site-main > .lsx-to-section .lsx-to-widget-item-wrap` on 2026-08-20: panel #ECE9E3 (neutral-200), padding 2.4rem 2rem 4.25rem, centred, title #60483B at 23px, image 360x168 rendered at 204px tall. Live hides the read-more inside the carousel and that is kept — the whole panel is the target. The deep bottom padding is live's, and it is what leaves room for the read-more on the non-carousel placements of the same card. Taxonomy rows are core/post-terms, which renders a
with a `.wp-block-post-terms__prefix` span rather than the

the meta rows use, so the panel's type rules are repeated for it. **Every link in the card is one colour**: `neutral-800`, `brand-600` on hover, no underline in either state — title, brand, type, travel style and connected destination alike. That includes the linked title, which therefore reads a step darker than the `neutral-700` on `elements.heading`; the heading colour is the fallback for the placements where the title is not a link. It replaced a `neutral-700` default plus a per-block `primary-500` on the Type row that left the four link rows at three different colours (dev, 2026-09-01). Set here rather than on each card so the three compact cards cannot drift; a card that overrides `elements.link` on one row is re-introducing the problem. Two things this style deliberately does not hold: the hover lift — a 4px rise and 200 → 300 on the shadow scale, in assets/styles/core-group.css because the `css` field strips `:hover` outright and mis-compiles `@media` — and the brand-500 Phosphor star masks that replace Tour Operator's rating PNGs, which are in the same file because a `css` field cannot carry a relative asset URL. The last css rule hides the empty paragraphs the accommodation card's rating row leaves behind: one where the HTML parser split the bound `

` in front of the `

` Tour Operator emits inside it, and the Rating Authority paragraph on a property whose `rating_type` is empty or "Unspecified" — TO's binding returns '' for both. Each is a zero-width flex item that still takes a gap on either side, so the row read as trailing space after the stars. `:empty` and not `:not(:has(> *))` here — these are bound paragraphs with no authored content, so they hold no whitespace text node and `:empty` matches, which is the opposite of the groups in post-grid-card.json. A prefixed paragraph whose *value* is empty is a different problem and is not solved here: TO prepends the prefix with no test on the value, so `

Regions:

` is not `:empty` and is indistinguishable from a real one-word value. That case is handled where it can be — by the `(lsx|facts)-*-wrapper` classes on the pattern's own rows, which TO removes server-side before the paragraph renders.

styles.css: & { overflow: hidden; height: 100%; } & strong { font-family: var(--wp--preset--font-family--heading); font-weight: var(--wp--custom--font-weight--semi-bold); } & .wp-block-post-terms__prefix { font-family: var(--wp--preset--font-family--heading); font-weight: var(--wp--custom--font-weight--semi-bold); } & p:empty { display: none; }
